title: How to Search for a Business
description: Use the homepage search bar, predictive dropdown, and category chips to find Greek-owned businesses across America quickly and accurately.

title: Using Predictive Search
description: Learn how the predictive search dropdown works — what it shows, how to navigate it with your keyboard, and how to get the most from it.

title: Browsing by Category
description: Use the category chips on the homepage or the /categories page to explore all Greek-owned businesses in a specific industry or type.

title: Understanding Search Results
description: Learn what information appears on listing cards in search results — badges, location, hours status, pricing, and how results are ranked.

title: What to Do When You Can't Find a Business
description: If a search returns no results or misses a business you're looking for, here are the steps to try before giving up or submitting a new listing.

title: How to Filter Listings
description: Open the filter panel on the listings page to narrow results by category, location, hours, pricing, and more. Works on both desktop and mobile.

title: Filtering by Category & Subcategory
description: Select a main category and drill down with subcategory checkboxes to find exactly the type of Greek-owned business you're looking for.

title: Subcategory Filter Modes: Any vs. All
description: When you select multiple subcategories, the filter mode controls whether listings must match at least one or every subcategory you've chosen.

title: Filtering by Location
description: Narrow listings to a specific country, state, city, or ZIP code using the location filters on the listings page.

title: Filtering by Distance (Radius)
description: Use the radius filter to show only listings within a set number of miles from your current location. Requires location permission or IP-based estimation.

title: Filtering by Hours
description: Use the Open Now, Closed Now, Opening Soon, and Closing Soon filters to find businesses based on their real-time hours status.

title: Filtering by Pricing
description: Use the pricing filter ($ to $$$$) to find businesses that match your budget. Pricing is set by the business owner as a general cost indicator.

title: Other Filters Explained
description: Learn about the Online Only and Coming Soon filters — what they mean and when to use them while browsing the directory.

title: Sorting Listings
description: Switch between Default, A–Z, Closest to Me, and Random sort orders on the listings page to find businesses the way you want.

title: Sharing or Bookmarking a Filtered View
description: Every filter you apply is reflected in the page URL, so you can bookmark or share a specific filtered view of the Greek Directory.

title: How to Read a Business Listing Page
description: A complete walkthrough of every section on a business listing page — photos, contact info, hours, map, social links, and more.

title: Understanding Verified, Featured & Premium Badges
description: Learn what the Verified, Featured, and Premium badges mean on a listing — what they signal to you as a visitor browsing the directory.

title: Business Hours & Open/Closed Status
description: Learn how business hours are displayed on listings, how the live Open/Closed badge works, and what Opening Soon and Closing Soon mean.

title: Pricing Indicators on a Listing
description: The $ to $$$$ pricing scale on listings gives you a rough sense of cost before you visit. Learn what each level means.

title: Photos & Media on a Listing
description: Navigate the photo carousel on a listing page and find out how to watch a video embed on Premium listings.

title: Contact Information on a Listing
description: Find a business's phone number, email, website, and address on their listing page — and how to use each one directly from the page.

title: Social Media & Review Links on a Listing
description: Find links to a business's social media profiles and review pages — Google, Yelp, TripAdvisor, Facebook, Instagram, and more.

title: Additional Info & Custom Buttons on a Listing
description: Some listings include extra details in an Additional Info section and custom call-to-action buttons — here's what they are and how to use them.

title: Coming Soon Listings
description: Some listings show a 'Coming Soon' badge. Learn what this means and how to stay informed about a business that's about to open.

title: Suggesting an Edit to a Listing
description: If you spot incorrect or outdated information on a listing, use the Suggest an Edit button to flag it for review by our team.

title: Chain & Franchise Listings
description: Some businesses in the directory are part of a chain or franchise. Learn how chain locations are grouped and displayed.

title: Using the Map View
description: Explore Greek-owned businesses on an interactive map. Learn how to toggle the map panel, use split view, and navigate the full-screen map.

title: Using Split View
description: Split view shows the listings list on the left and an interactive map on the right simultaneously — the best way to explore and compare businesses.

title: Clicking a Map Marker
description: Learn what happens when you tap a pin on the map — what the popup shows, and how to navigate from there to the full listing page.

title: The Full-Screen Map Page
description: The /map page gives you the entire screen as an interactive map of all Greek-owned businesses. Learn how to use its category filters and location search.

title: Getting Directions to a Business
description: Tap the Directions button on any listing to launch navigation in your preferred map app — Apple Maps, Google Maps, or Waze.

title: Understanding Map Marker Priority
description: Featured and Premium listings appear on top of other pins when markers overlap. Learn how tier-based z-index works on the map.

title: Location Permission & Near Me Features
description: Learn what happens when you allow or deny location access, how IP-based location estimation works, and which features require precise location.

title: Estimated Location vs. Precise Location
description: TGD uses two types of location data — an automatic IP-based city estimate and optional GPS-based precise location. Here's the difference and when each is used.

title: How to Star a Business
description: Tap the star icon on any listing card or listing page to save a business to your favorites. The star turns gold immediately to confirm it's been saved.

title: Viewing Your Starred Listings
description: Access all the businesses you've saved with the star button — from the header, the Starred page, or the PWA dock.

title: Unstarring a Business
description: Remove a business from your favorites by tapping its gold star again on any listing card or listing page.

title: Starred Listings Across Multiple Tabs
description: When you star or unstar a business, all open TGD tabs update automatically. Here's how cross-tab syncing works.

title: Starring Listings in the PWA (Offline Access)
description: In the installed Greek Directory app, starred businesses are saved with their photos for offline viewing — even without an internet connection.

title: Why Did My Stars Disappear?
description: If your starred businesses are gone, the most likely cause is cleared browser data. Here's why it happens and what you can do.

title: What Is the Greek Directory App?
description: The Greek Directory is an installable Progressive Web App (PWA). Learn what that means, how it differs from a regular website, and why you'd want to install it.

title: Installing on iPhone (iOS)
description: Step-by-step instructions for adding The Greek Directory to your iPhone or iPad home screen using Safari's Share menu.

title: Installing on Android
description: Step-by-step instructions for installing The Greek Directory on your Android phone or tablet using Chrome's Install App prompt.

title: Navigating with the Dock
description: The installed PWA app has a bottom navigation dock with five tabs. Learn what each tab does, how the More menu works, and how to use the dock efficiently.

title: Customizing Your Dock
description: Reorder, add, or remove tabs from the PWA dock in the Settings tab. Make the bottom navigation bar work the way you want.

title: Using the App Offline
description: The installed Greek Directory PWA works without an internet connection for core pages and starred listings. Here's exactly what's available offline and what isn't.

title: Dark Mode, Light Mode & System Theme
description: Switch between light mode, dark mode, or follow your device's system setting in the Greek Directory app's Settings tab.

title: Auto-Hide Dock on Scroll
description: The dock can automatically hide when you scroll down and reappear when you scroll up — freeing up screen space while reading listings.

title: Updating the App
description: The Greek Directory PWA updates automatically in the background. Learn how to know when an update is ready and how to apply it immediately.

title: Hard Refresh vs. Reset
description: The Settings tab has two powerful options — Hard Refresh and Reset App. Learn the difference and when to use each one.

title: Opening Links in Your Browser Instead of the App
description: In the installed PWA, external links automatically open in your system browser. Learn how this works and why it's designed that way.

title: Switching Between English and Greek
description: Toggle the site language between English and Greek (Ελληνικά) using the flag switch in the site header. Your preference is saved for future visits.

title: How the Language Toggle Works
description: A look at the technical side of the English/Greek toggle — what it changes under the hood, including the GTranslate integration and localStorage preference.

title: Greek Language Offline
description: When you're offline in the PWA app, some Greek-language UI strings are available from a local cache. Here's what's translated offline and how it works.

title: How to Submit a Business Listing
description: If a Greek-owned business isn't in the directory yet, you can submit it for review using the public submission form at /submit-listing.

title: What Happens After You Submit a Listing
description: After submitting a business, our team reviews it before it goes live. Here's what to expect during the review process and when your listing will appear.

title: Choosing the Right Category & Subcategories
description: Picking the right category and subcategories for a submission helps visitors find the business. Here's guidance on making the best choice.

title: Submission Requirements
description: What information is required vs. optional when submitting a business listing, and tips for making your submission as strong as possible.

title: Can I Submit a Business I Don't Own?
description: Yes — anyone can submit a Greek-owned business to the directory. You don't need to be the owner. Here's how it works and what happens next.

title: Why Is a Business Not Showing Up in Search?
description: If you searched for a business and can't find it, here are the most common reasons and how to check each one.

title: Why Does My Location Look Wrong?
description: TGD estimates your location using your IP address, which can be inaccurate. Here's why it happens and how to get a more accurate location.

title: The Site Says I'm Offline — What Now?
description: If The Greek Directory is showing an offline page or not loading, here's what to check and how to get back online.

title: Browser & Device Compatibility
description: The Greek Directory works on all modern browsers and devices. Here's a breakdown of supported environments and what to do if something doesn't work.

title: How to Report Incorrect Business Information
description: If a listing has wrong or outdated information, use the Suggest an Edit button on the listing page to flag it for our team.

title: Privacy & Data: What Does The Greek Directory Collect?
description: A plain-language overview of what data TGD stores on your device, what's tracked when you interact with listings, and how cookies are used.
